name: WCC Cross Country Championships
headline: WCC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: San Francisco won the women's title with 28 points, ahead of Portland (57) and Santa Clara (84), while Portland's Latham West took the individual win in 20:31.2. Portland won the men's title with 32 points to San Francisco's 65, and Portland's Nolan Turgeon won the 8K in 24:25.8.
